title: Q-REDMAIN-revert-lane: the lane reverts or repairs a red main without a workflow edit
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** every lane pass
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/redmain.js::revertRedMain
**Status:** closed

Red main today is gated only by the deploy-site REDMAIN-1 check. Add to the tick Worker sweeper (seed/worker/src/redmain.js) a pass that reads the latest main commit status, and when the gate is red for more than 15 minutes opens a revert PR of the offending squash commit through the git data API and merges it on green (regenerating generated files). Also wire the watchdog git-add list for ops/yearsim*, ops/saydo*, ops/trajectory* (workflow path, needs the executor surface).

size: M

**Closing probe:** `grep seed/worker/src/redmain.js for revertRedMain` finds it.


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-21T19:31:08Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-22T01:33:12Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-22T01:41:06Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: grep:seed/worker/src/redmain.js::revertRedMain
